header: One bar per item, on one shared scale
lead: No chart library ships with this theme: each bar is a grid cell whose width is the number typed on its row, read as a percentage of the plot. Scale the values yourself before entering them, and say in the caption what scale you used.
caption: The caption names the scale — without it the lengths compare nothing
note: Below 640px the bar drops to its own line, because three columns in a phone width leave a plot about a centimetre wide.

metrics.title: The top of the scale
metrics.text: Clamped, so a row entered above a hundred stops at the full width.

metrics.title: Nothing typed
metrics.text: Reads as zero, never as full.
